resources.string: Persistent notice while LanChat is available to receive messages.
New messages from devices on the network.
Notice when there\'s a new version of LanChat.

To notify you as soon as a message arrives, LanChat needs to keep running in the background. If Android pauses it to save battery, messages may arrive minutes late.\n\nOn the next screen choose “Allow”. You can change it later in LanChat\'s Settings.

Without the “Nearby devices” (local network) permission, Android blocks LanChat from finding and talking to the other devices in the office, so you won\'t see anyone.\n\nIn the app\'s settings, open Permissions and allow “Nearby devices”.
